存储上限通过定期采样检查（有执行时每 2 秒查磁盘余量、每 30 秒扫描占用），: Storage limits are enforced by periodic sampling (disk space every 2s and folder size every 30s while runs are active), not by a filesystem write-layer hard quota, so they cannot guarantee the drive will never fill.

打开后该账号不保存 Key：上传、下载和删除都由你这台电脑代为签发，只能操作该账: When on, the account keeps no key: this computer signs its uploads, downloads and deletions, only within the account's own folder, and enforces its space quota here. Your local service must keep running.
每个账号一份云空间，建在资源中心的对象存储上：大于门槛的附件（最大 2 GiB）: Each account has one cloud space on the resource center's object storage. Attachments over the threshold (up to 2 GiB) are kept there, so large files sent in rooms and large deliverables from members can be taken from it; files can also be uploaded straight into it under “Cloud space” on the Files page of the room website. There are no folders. Set automatic deletion or delete files under “Manage cloud space”. Without it only attachments within the limit can be sent. The bucket must allow cross-origin uploads from the web page's address. Each account uses its own key, kept with its API keys.
